name: Senche

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.description: The Senche attacks with both paws, hitting twice for minor physical damage each.

abilities.name: Surround
abilities.description: The Senche positions in a different direction from its target.

abilities.name: Backstabber
abilities.description: The Senche has a passive ability that causes it to deal 20% more damage when attacking the target's back.

notes: Some senche are tame and passive, unable to be attacked, but wild ones will usually attack you on sight.

They come in several colors: the typical orange tiger pattern, a gray tiger pattern (senche of this color are sometimes referred to as "mist tigers"), solid black, and even a spotted variety. The creatures are labeled as 'Senche' and 'Senche-Tiger' in-game.
Several Senche mounts and pets are available from the Crown Store.
related_quests: The Common Good: Kill a dangerous beast which has been smuggled to the Gold Coast from Craglorn.
Fires of Battle: Compete in a fiery arena to claim the Brimstone Crown.
Keepers of the Shell: Save a generation of Argonians from the Dominion.
Knowledge Gained: Help guide a Mages Guild expedition through a dangerous forest.
Pledge: Blessed Crucible: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Blessed Crucible.
Pledge: Selene's Web: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Selene's Web.
The Prisoner of Jathsogur: Free the Silvenar from the Drublog ritual.
The Roar of the Crowds: Defeat a Kvatch Arena champion.
summary: Senche are large, quadrupedal felines found in Elsweyr and Valenwood. Variants include senche-leopards, senche-lions, senche-panthers and senche-tigers. They are sometimes referred to as senche-cats. Black senche can be found competing alongside the Khajiit hunters and stalkers in the Blessed Crucible's Frozen Arena.
